description: Somalia Road Access, April 2017 is a data set listed in Africa GeoPortal (Esri), a continental ArcGIS Hub, published or maintained by ArcGIS StoryMaps. This data set provides a selection of roads, routes, and trails in Somalia whose accessibility status for humanitarian aid was updated as of April 2017. Created by UNWFP. Used in On the Front Lines of Famine. Coverage: Somalia. The portal files it under the publisher ArcGIS StoryMaps. Its tags are somalia, road, access, humanitarian, united nations. The portal shows 2017-07-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is custom rights statement written on the portal listing (long text, see the linked page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record platform-africa-geoportal-esri.
